title: [Nichibei] Apply to Next X Lessons – Select a LA – Archived LA Not Selectable (Control Case)
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case, not a gap: Code-confirmed LessonMasterHandler.cls:46 already filters Archived_At__c = NULL for the student/LA search feeding this bulk-assign flow.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is on the Calendar SF view with a recurring/custom lesson chain available
Student A has an archived Lesson Allocation for the relevant course (Archived_At__c populated); Student B has an active Lesson Allocation for the same course
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the student/LA search panel and searches for Student A"
2. "HQ or CM Staff searches for Student B"
steps_result:
1. "Student A's archived Lesson Allocation does not appear as a selectable candidate"
2. "Student B's active Lesson Allocation appears and is selectable"
steps_data:
1. "Student A LA Archived_At__c = populated - excluded"
2. "Student B LA Archived_At__c = null - shown"
suite: Assign a student on Calendar SF

title: [Nichibei] Apply to Next X Lessons – Duplicate Check – Archived-Only Existing Session Does Not Block Re-Assignment (Control Case)
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case, not a gap: Code-confirmed StudentSessionsHandler.cls:2373-2385 filters Is_Deleted__c = FALSE AND Is_Archived__c = FALSE before building the dedup map.
preconditions:
Student A previously had a Student Session for Lesson 3 in the chain, but that session's Lesson Allocation has since archived (Archived_At__c populated), so the session is Is_Archived__c = TRUE
HQ or CM Staff selects a new, active Lesson Allocation for Student A and starts "Apply to Next X Lessons" from Lesson 1, with X covering Lesson 3
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff selects the active LA and assigns Student A with 'Apply to Next X Lessons' covering Lessons 1 through 4 (including Lesson 3)"
2. "HQ or CM Staff checks Lesson 3's Student Sessions"
steps_result:
1. "Per the dedup check's Is_Archived__c = FALSE filter, Student A is treated as not currently assigned to Lesson 3 and receives a fresh Student Session there, not skipped"
2. "Two Student Session records exist for Student A on Lesson 3: the old archived one (preserved for history) and a new active one tied to the new LA"
steps_data:
1. "Old Lesson 3 session Is_Archived__c = TRUE - excluded from dedup map"
2. "Expect: 1 archived + 1 active session, no error or skip"
suite: Assign a student on Calendar SF

title: [Nichibei] Apply to Next X Lessons – Lesson Allocation Archived – Bulk-Assigned Sessions Hidden; Restored – Sessions Reappear
description: AC-5 - Regression: Confirms the general Is_Archived__c formula principle also holds for sessions created via this separate bulk-assign LWC, since it's a different code path worth its own confirmation.
preconditions: HQ or CM Staff selected an LA and bulk-assigned Student A to Lessons 1-4 via "Apply to Next X Lessons" (X = 4). Student A currently appears in all 4 lessons' Student Sessions, Is_Archived__c = FALSE
steps_actions:
1. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
2. "HQ or CM Staff reopens Lessons 1-4's Student Session lists"
3. "A living Student Package Order reappears for the same Student_Course_ID__c group, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
4. "HQ or CM Staff reopens Lessons 1-4's Student Session lists"
steps_result:
1. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
2. "Student A no longer appears in any of the 4 lessons - all 4 sessions' Is_Archived__c = TRUE via formula"
3. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
4. "Student A reappears in all 4 lessons - the same original sessions, not newly created"
steps_data:
1. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
2. "All 4 sessions hidden"
3. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
4. "All 4 sessions Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored)"
suite: Assign a student on Calendar SF

title: [Nichibei] Restore – Recomputed Total Session Count Smaller Than Retained Sessions – Lesson Allocation Surfaces as Over Assigned
description: AC-3 - Decision Table - [UNVERIFIED]: Unarchiving recomputes Total_Session_Count__c from only the orders living at restore time; since archiving never deletes sessions, a smaller recomputed total than the retained session count can flip the LA to Over Assigned immediately on restore.
preconditions:
Student A's Lesson Allocation originally had Purchased_Slot_Number/Total_Session_Count = 10, with exactly 10 active Student Sessions assigned (Allocated_Sessions__c = 10, Status = normal, not Over Assigned)
The full order group is removed, archiving the Lesson Allocation (Archived_At__c populated). The 10 Student Sessions become Is_Archived__c = TRUE but are not deleted
Only a subset of the original orders reappears as living - enough to support a recomputed Total_Session_Count__c of 6, not the original 10 - and the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff confirms the Lesson Allocation is restored and checks Total_Session_Count__c"
2. "HQ or CM Staff checks the 10 original Student Sessions"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Lesson Allocation record and checks its Status"
steps_result:
1. "Per AC-3, the recomputed value reflects only the living orders - 6, not the original 10"
2. "All 10 are restored to Is_Archived__c = FALSE - none were deleted by the archive/restore cycle, since archiving never touches Is_Deleted__c"
3. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: Status shows 'Over Assigned' (10 > 6) immediately upon restore, surfacing a condition that did not exist before the archive - expected consequence of AC-3's recompute rule, not a defect in the archive mechanism itself, but staff must be made aware it can happen"
steps_data:
1. "Total_Session_Count__c = 6 (recomputed)"
2. "Allocated_Sessions__c rollup = 10 (unchanged, filtered only by Is_Deleted__c)"
3. "Status__c = Over Assigned if Allocated_Sessions__c (10) > Total_Session_Count__c (6)"
suite: Assign a student on Calendar SF
